messages:
alice: Heads-up — I'm doing a miniworkshop refresh for the Quickstart (hello-minima). Goal: simplify auth, add a one-click deploy badge, and shorten first-deploy section.

maria: love it. which quickstart are you touching? link?

alice: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4382 — branch miniworkshop/quickstart-rewrite

cheng: will take a look later today. is this the auth flow that uses the SDK 6 pattern?

alice: yes — switching examples to SDK v6 auth helper. Also added a tiny curl fallback. snippet:
```
# get token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/auth/token -d 'grant_type=client_credentials' -u 'CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET'
# call quickstart
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sam: can we also show the env var setup for cloud-run? ppl keep missing the PORT var

alice: good call — added short note and a deploy button that uses the env template. @jen can you sanity-check the button envs?

jen: yep, quick skim — two nits: the SECRET_KEY var name should be REDWOOD_API_KEY and the sample uses REDWOOD_SVC_TOKEN. I'll push a tiny fix.

docs-bot: PR 4382 updated: jen pushed 1 commit (fix/env-var-name)

maria: leaving an in-line comment about the wording in the 'first request' section — it's a bit heavy on infra assumptions.

alice: noted, reworded to "first deploy (no infra required)". also trimmed the 'hot reload' section.

cheng: LGTM apart from one edge-case: when using local dev port 3000 the SDK auto-retries with 302; added a note in comments. I'll mark approve after that.

sam: I can run the sample in a fresh account and smoke test the deploy button later today.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4382--docs.redwood.com (build OK)

alice: thanks everyone — aiming to merge by EOD if tests pass. request: please add :eyes: on the PR if you plan to review.

maria: added :eyes: and a couple of small edits. thanks for doing this miniworkshop refresh :sparkles:

sam: smoke test passed, badge works, one-click deploy creates cloud-run service with envs.

alice: merging now. will follow up with a quick changelog blurb for the release notes.

deploy-bot: PR 4382 merged into main by alice — docs site updated :shipit:
